information_flow: The first call alone sees all six common inputs and converts them into non-policy evidence analysis without creating an executable artifact. The final call consumes only that immediately preceding analysis, has no direct visibility into external inputs or an inherited policy artifact, exercises sole policy authorship, and emits one complete policy.
name: Deferred-Instantiation Evidence Bottleneck
organization: two-call sequential lineage with one analysis-only handoff and one sole policy author

calls.objective: Reconcile the supplied evidence into one coherent non-policy charter that identifies obligations, tensions, and behavioral priorities while withholding all policy-artifact authorship.
Consume synthesize_preartifact_charter as the sole visible evidence, exercise undivided authorship to materialize exactly one complete policy, and emit that policy.
calls.role: sole policy author with predecessor-only visibility
